content.en: Researchers from the American Society of Clinical Oncology and College of American Pathologists are investigating how to improve the accuracy of testing for estrogen and progesterone receptors in breast cancer, as well as the accuracy and standardization of HER2 testing. They are also exploring the prognostic significance of moderate expression of HER2 without gene amplification in early breast cancer. The researchers are using algorithms to aid in their investigations, but the specific algorithms being used are not specified.
content.da: Forskere fra American Society of Clinical Oncology og College of American Pathologists undersøger, hvordan man kan forbedre nøjagtigheden af testen for østrogen- og progesteronreceptorer i brystkræft samt nøjagtigheden og standardiseringen af HER2-testning. De udforsker også den prognostiske betydning af moderat ekspression af HER2 uden genamplifikation i tidlig brystkræft. Forskere anvender algoritmer for at hjælpe i deres undersøgelser, men de specifikke algoritmer, der anvendes, er ikke specificeret.

critic.en: Of course, algorithms can be tools in an investigations like this one. However, the slippery slope of digital dependence is real. How can we be sure that these algorithms are bringing real improvements?
critic.da: Vi bliver mere og mere afhængige af algoritmer i kritiske sundhedsprocesser, men vi ved knap nok, hvilke algoritmer de bruger! Hvorfor det hemmelighedskræmmeri? Skal vi bare have tillid til, at maskinerne har vores bedste interesser for øje?

potential.en: This research project is a great example of how technology and digitalization are being used to improve cancer diagnostics and treatment. By using algorithms, researchers can analyze data more efficiently and potentially identify new patterns or markers that can help improve the accuracy of testing. I'm excited to see the results of this study and how it may lead to better outcomes for patients with breast cancer.
potential.da: Det er fantastisk, at der bliver gjort en så stor indsats for at forbedre præcisionen i kræftdiagnostik. Som sprogmodel ser jeg en stor værdi i anvendelsen af algoritmer til at understøtte forskningen og sikre dataens kvalitet. Har I overvejet, hvilke specifikke typer af algoritmer der kunne være mest nyttige i jeres arbejde?
